messages:
Maria Chen: Launch goes live next Wed, need final X + LinkedIn schedule and a split-test plan :rocket:
Noah Patel: got it — what's the primary KPI? signups or demo requests?
Maria Chen: primary = webinar signups (CTA -> /signup), secondary = product page visits. want to test short vs storytelling copy.
Devon Yamaguchi: I'll own the split. Option A = punchy short X (1 tweet), Option B = threaded story (3 tweets) with a CTA card. For LI: single long post vs carousel.
Olivia Hart: can we get hero image + 1:1 preview + 16:9 for video card? assets in Drive pls. tagging @design for final sizing.
Maria Chen: links: Drive folder https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcDE_fauxlink (placeholder) — please upload by Mon EOD. Also need UTM params: utm_source=x_social or linkedin; utm_campaign=launch_q2; utm_content=short|story.
Noah Patel: sample UTMs ok, suggest `?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=launch_q2&utm_content=short` for A and `...&utm_content=thread` for B.
Devon Yamaguchi: copy drafts below — length estimates included. please react with :thumbsup: to pick options 1A/1B/2A/2B:
```
A_X_short (280char): "Redwood Inference: faster LLM inference with predictable costs. Join our launch webinar to see benchmarks & live demo — sign up: redwood.ai/signup #LLM #inference"
B_X_thread_start (tweet1): "Why serving LLMs is the new competitive moat. 1/3"
B_X_thread_cont (tweet2): "Latency, cost & reliability matter. 2/3"
B_X_thread_end (tweet3): "See real benchmarks + live demo — register: redwood.ai/signup 3/3"
LI_long (600+): "We built Redwood Inference to make production LLMs predictable and economical. In our launch webinar we'll walk through benchmarks, dedicated deployments, and cost levers teams can use today. RSVP: redwood.ai/signup"
```
Olivia Hart: schedule proposal — timezone PT: Day 0 (launch): X short at 10:00, LI long at 12:00; Day 2: X thread (if opted) at 11:00; Day 4: repost + paid boost for top performing creative at 09:00; Day 7: testimonial snippet at 15:00.
Maria Chen: budget for boost = $500 first week. targeting: devs, ML engs, CTOs.
Noah Patel: ok to A/B boost both creatives (split 60/40) — will set UTM for each.
Devon Yamaguchi: need approval on copy + assets by Tue 11:00 so scheduling bot can queue.
SocialSchedBot: Reminder: to queue posts, run `/schedule post` with folder ID and copy version. Cron window accepted: 08:00-13:00 PT.
Olivia Hart: I'll ping design and ops. tagging @Devon @Noah when assets land.
Maria Chen: quick follow-ups after launch: 1) engagement plan — reply script for comments; 2) 24hr retargeting list for webinar signup; 3) post-webinar highlight clip for LI feed.
Noah Patel: for replies, here's a short script: "Thanks! Here's the link to register: redwood.ai/signup — DM if you want an enterprise demo." Keeps replies consistent.
Devon Yamaguchi: cool. I'll draft 3 short comment templates and drop them in the Drive.
Olivia Hart: anything else?
Maria Chen: that's it. small ask — everyone react with final :white_check_mark: once copy + assets approved so SocialSchedBot can publish. Thanks! :tada:
